qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Scale economies shared coupled with high switching costs from deep shop-floor integration. Fastenal's dense local hub-and-spoke distribution, captive trucking fleet, ~1,800+ Onsite locations, and >110,000 FMI (Fastenal Managed Inventory) vending devices lower customer total procurement and inventory carrying costs by 20-30% while generating industry-leading ~20-21% EBIT margins. 10-year GAAP ROIC has consistently remained between 24% and 35% (median 34.2%). Demonstrated pricing power by consistently passing through raw material (steel) and tariff inflation without gross margin degradation. Primary erosion threat is digital disintermediation (e.g., Amazon Business), but pure-play e-commerce lacks captive last-mile delivery, custom bin-stocking, and emergency factory-floor replenishment.
qualitative.note: Passes all 6 gates. Premier North American industrial distributor with insurmountable shop-floor moats (Onsite embedded branches and FMI automated vending). High capital efficiency (10Y median ROIC ~34%) and fortress net-cash balance sheet. Resilient to all 5 macrotrends and an active beneficiary of manufacturing automation and reshoring. [5-10Y g: Onsite and FMI volume share gains 5.5% + pricing power 1.5% + mix and digital leverage 0.5% + net share repurchases 0.5%]
qualitative.evidence: 10-year financial compounding: Net sales grew from $3,962.0M (2016) to $8,200.5M (2025); EBIT expanded from $795.8M to $1,655.7M with stable operating margins of 20-21%. GAAP ROIC consistently ranged between 24.1% and 35.1% (median 34.2%), with identical tangible ROIC reflecting organic growth and negligible goodwill. Free cash flow conversion over 5 years is ~85% ($1,108.3M Owner FCF on $1,258.4M net income in 2025). Long-term debt is negligible at $100.0M against $276.8M cash and $1,655.7M EBIT, generating an interest coverage ratio exceeding 250x. Installed FMI device footprint exceeds 110,000 units and Onsite locations exceed 1,800, creating deeply entrenched customer retention.
